headline: 355 COMANCHE'S PRICE OBJECTION BROKE — Monday's buyer filed interested YES, priced JUST RIGHT and staging 5 of 5, the first validating read this listing has ever produced and the first since the cut to $295,000 — while the two agents who called it too high at $299,000 still have not been told it moved.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 Amber G. of Keller Williams Hoover filed the first validating read in this listing's life off her Monday 8/10 1:40 PM tour: interested — YES · priced right — JUST RIGHT · staging — 5 of 5, the highest it has ever scored · price-change recommendation, staging suggestions and main-thing all BLANK. She also texted mid-tour asking whether the ceiling stains came from a previous leak — an agent who raises a condition question and then files interested YES is working a real buyer.
hotSignals.action: CALL HER. ⭐ THE ARGUMENT WRITES ITSELF AND IT IS EVIDENCE, NOT OPINION: every earlier read that touched the number said TOO HIGH — 7/25, 8/2 and the dead written offer — and every one was filed while the ask was still $299,000. The $4,000 cut went live 8/5. This is the first read since and the objection is gone. ⚠️ HAVE THE CEILING-STAIN ANSWER READY before you dial; it is on the record and no answer appears anywhere. ⛔ Quote $295,000 and nothing else — she called it just right, so a discount would answer a question nobody asked. ⛔ No email sent and none drafted: buyer's agents are the red lane under the 8/7 rule. The call is the whole product.

hotSignals.signal: Wanda W. of Millennium Homes answered the interest question on her Sat 8/8 12:50 PM showing with the single word "Very" — and left every other field on the form blank. She filed a second form ninety seconds later for a different buyer on a different showing that came back not interested, so the enthusiasm is specific to one buyer, not a stray click.
hotSignals.action: Call her — the enthusiasm is on record and the reason is not, which is exactly what a phone call is for. ✅ ALREADY ALERTED 8/9 and a p1 chip exists; this is a four-day-old hit that survived the machine handover unworked. ⭐ AND THE STRATEGY NOTE THAT MATTERS MORE THAN THE CALL: three showings ran that Saturday and the verified objection across them is SIZE, not price — one agent wrote simply "Just too small." ⛔ NO DISCOUNT REACHES A SIZE OBJECTION. Point the marketing at first-time buyers, downsizers and investors instead, and do not pair it with a price reduction.

hotSignals.signal: THE $5,000 CUT IS NOW VERIFIED LIVE AND PUBLIC — all three Saturday notices print the MLS line at $184,000, where every notice through July read $189,000. Three showings landed in a single day on a listing that had gone twenty days without one.
hotSignals.action: Quote $184,000 freely — the standing "cut approved but unverified, do not quote" hedge this board carried for three weeks is retired on a primary source. ⭐ AND THE TWENTY-DAY-SILENCE READ IS WITHDRAWN: this board argued for weeks that the silence itself justified a price conversation. The showings arrived and said something different, and the earlier read was wrong. ⚠️ The ad on this listing has produced zero leads in ten days after being the best performer on record in July — that, not the price, is the lane to fix.

hotSignals.signal: 🎉 UNDER CONTRACT AT $162,000 — the Mallory W. buyer who "really, really liked it" but needed to save more for her down payment DID write. Offer to acceptance in twenty-eight minutes. The MLS line on today's notice reads CONTINGENT and the buyer's inspection is confirmed for tomorrow morning.
hotSignals.action: ⏰ THE INSPECTION IS TOMORROW 8/13 AT 10:00 AM — that is the next real gate on this file. ⭐ WORTH RECORDING AS A JUDGEMENT THAT PAID: every board since 8/3 said do not read her down-payment gap as a price signal, because she wrote JUST RIGHT in the same form. The blocker was financing TIMING and patience converted it. ⭐ It also retires the expiring-agreement problem on this unit — a contract solves an expiry more permanently than an extension does.

hotSignals.action: Chase that read tomorrow morning while the Amber G. call is still fresh — two independent reads on the $295,000 price inside seventy-two hours would settle the pricing question completely, in either direction. ⭐ The pattern this board has proven twice now is that a DIRECT EMAIL to the agent produces an answer in minutes where the automated form reminder produces nothing in days.

upcoming: ⏰ TOMORROW — Thu 8/13 10:00 AM — 3350 ALTAMONT ROAD Unit E21, Birmingham. BUYER'S INSPECTION on the new contract. $162,000 · CONTINGENT.
